finalReading.passage: When Mai started learning Japanese, her friends asked why she bothered, since she already spoke English well. She kept going, and within a year she could enjoy Japanese stories that no translation could fully capture. Looking back, she felt that each new language had quietly given her a fresh way of seeing the world.

questions.q: Why did Mai's friends question her choice?
options: They thought knowing English was already enough.
They wanted her to study French instead.
They believed she spoke no English.
questions.explanation: 原文'since she already spoke English well'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mai feel about language learning later?
options: Each language had broadened how she understood the world.
She found the whole effort useless.
She had forgotten all her English.
questions.explanation: 末句'a fresh way of seeing the world'的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
